# ImageGrid

Virtualized media grid: shows images or other items as a grid of thumbnails; even with tens of thousands of
items only the visible part is rendered, and tiles can be selected with the keyboard. The height comes from the
parent (it fills the parent's height by default); the background follows the surrounding container.

**Interaction**: tiles are buttons; `Tab` shows an inset focus ring and `Enter` / `Space` open the tile
(`onOpen`). On hover, image tiles lift slightly and the image zooms in slowly; pressing does not scale them.
Image tiles have no state layer, so the look of the images is not changed. Tiles without an image that show
their `fallback` have a neutral fill, show the state layer on hover and press, and do not lift. Tiles in
`selectedIds` show an accent selection ring.

**Category**: Media · **Common uses**: Albums and galleries, grid views of assets or attachments, picking images

## Import

```ts
import { ImageGrid } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Click an image to view it larger in a Lightbox; the height of the container comes from its parent.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const items = useMemo(() => sampleImages(60), [])
  const [index, setIndex] = useState<number | null>(null)
  return (
    <DemoFrame>
      <ImageGrid items={items} onOpen={(i) => setIndex(i)} />
      <Lightbox
        open={index !== null}
        items={items}
        index={index ?? 0}
        onIndexChange={setIndex}
        onClose={() => setIndex(null)}
      />
    </DemoFrame>
  )
}
```

## States

### Empty state

```tsx
export function Empty() {
  return (
    <DemoFrame>
      <ImageGrid items={[]} />
    </DemoFrame>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly ImageGridItem[]` | Images to show. | — | Yes |
| `onOpen` | `(index: number, item: ImageGridItem) => void` | Opens an item on click or `Enter` (usually in a Lightbox). | — | No |
| `overscan` | `number` | Number of rows rendered outside the viewport (overscan), 3 by default. | — | No |
| `onHover` | `(index: number, item: ImageGridItem) => void` | Called when a tile is hovered or focused; use it to prefetch the full image or prepare drag data. | — | No |
| `onTileDragStart` | `(index: number, item: ImageGridItem, event: DragEvent) => void` | When set, tiles can be dragged; called in `dragstart` (set the drag data or start a custom drag here). | — | No |
| `captionPlacement` | `'below' \| 'overlay'` | Position of the caption: `below` (default) under the tile; `overlay` on hover, as a gradient overlay at the bottom of the image, which keeps the grid cleaner and the images more prominent (the overlay uses the neutral viewer background tokens). | — | No |
| `selectedIds` | `ReadonlySet<string>` | IDs of the selected tiles (shown with an accent selection ring). | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
